name: Message Scheduler
shortDescription: Compose a message to be sent at a later date
description: Schedule messages with the /delay slash command, delivered later and sent as you, to the current channel, to other #channels, or as a direct message to @mentioned users. Supports relative delays (5m, 8h30m) and natural times (8am tomorrow, 10am next monday) in each user's own timezone. Manage pending messages with an interactive list: cancel or expand any message with one click.
